name: Bitter sneezeweed
desc: Bitter sneezeweed (Helenium amarum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 14 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Helenium amarum is a species of annual herb in the daisy family known by the common names yellowdicks, yellow sneezeweed, fiveleaf sneezeweed, and bitter sneezeweed.
